aboutTeaser.subtitle: Who We Are
aboutTeaser.paragraph1: Rysgally Gün, an ISO 9001:2015 certified company, delivers comprehensive solutions for Turkmenistan's oil & gas, power, and petrochemical industries. We specialize in construction, procurement, maintenance, precision machining, and advanced inspection services.
aboutTeaser.paragraph2: As a proud Turkmen company, we are committed to sustainable development. By adhering to the strictest national and international standards, we minimize operational risks and completely eliminate unnecessary downtime for our clients.
aboutTeaser.imageAlt: Industrial facility operated by Rysgally Gün
aboutTeaser.commitmentStatement: Minimizing risks and downtime through uncompromising precision.
